$comment: The training corpus generated from the tr-* briefs: one project per family x framework, each with its tree hash. `node scripts/scaffold-training-corpus.mjs` re-derives every tree; a hash here must never collide with a hash in pilot/CORPUS.json (original or uplift), which is the disjointness the corpus exists to guarantee.

no-autofill.rule: forms/autofill-sign-up-form (and forms/autofill-address-form where the archetype declares those fields)

client-only-state.reason: deletes the server INSERT; outside the uplift contract and makes the original non-runnable

enter-submits.reason: no uplift transform measures or rewrites premature Enter submission

accept-invalid-amount.reason: no uplift transform for the min attribute or server-side bound

no-field-labels.reason: no uplift transform for field labels
